title: Truth of the Sacrifice
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji finally saw the true price of the Heavenly Fate Lock, he found himself standing at a crossroads from which there was no return—and Chen Nian on the altar was shaking her head at him with her last consciousness.

text.content: The moment that black light tore through the sky, Chen Ji's steps faltered. Above the heavens within a hundred li, seventeen Nascent Soul auras closed in on him like hungry wolves—the Holy Sect's distress signal was faster and more lethal than he had anticipated. Among those auras, at least three had reached the late Nascent Soul stage, enough to crush this Foundation Building cultivator into dust. He didn't look back, instead pushing his escape light to its absolute limit, racing toward the core of the sacrifice. His Heavenly Fate Value had only thirty-seven points remaining, and the ritual's completion was no more than a quarter hour away.

The blood-red altar stood above the abyss, with nine black iron chains descending from the Void, enveloping a thousand zhang radius in thick demonic energy. The chains bore bizarre symbols that emanated a nauseating, blood-tinged aura. Chen Ji crouched in concealment, his sharp gaze slicing through layers of mist—a slender figure hung suspended in the altar's center, suspended midway by the chains, surrounded by peculiar golden symbols. Golden light flickered, revealing the person's face—thin and pallid.

Chen Nian. His younger sister, the closest relative taken by the Holy Sect to serve as the Heavenly Fate Lock. Eleven years of searching, eleven years of intricate planning, countless life-and-death moments—all leading to this instant. He remembered when she was taken at seven, hiding behind their mother, watching those black-robed figures drag her away with fearful eyes. He recalled kneeling at the sect's gates for three days and nights, begging them to send someone to rescue her, only to be met with 'such is her fate'.

dialogue.content: Brother... brother..." Chen Nian's voice was barely a whisper, yet it pierced Chen Ji's heart like a thousand arrows. Her voice was hoarse and weak, as if it might dissipate in the wind at any moment. "Don't... don't worry about me... run..." Her lips trembled slightly, seemingly exerting her final strength to prevent him from approaching, with tears glistening in her eyes.

text.content: "Don't worry about her?" A cold, fierce smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth, while an overwhelming killing intent churned in his eyes. For eleven years, he had searched for her—eleven years from a worthless servant to a schemer manipulating the world. Every move he made, every step of his plan, was for this precise moment. He had learned to endure, to disguise himself, to play the role of a cowardly, incompetent wretch before everyone—only waiting for the day he would have enough strength to snatch her back from these people's hands.

At this moment, the Tianji Record patterns on his right hand suddenly lit up—the fourth page was awakening! Golden characters surged into his Mental Sea like a tide, presenting a clear vision: nine black iron chains, each connected to the foundation of a sealing formation. Only by simultaneously destroying all nine anchor points would the ritual be interrupted. And each anchor point was buried with sufficient forbidden formations to kill a Nascent Soul cultivator. The Tianji Record provided the method, but also the warning—if he failed, his soul would be completely annihilated.

choice.prompt: Nine anchor points, seventeen Nascent Soul auras, a quarter hour—Chen Ji, how will you choose?

choices.description: Destroy all nine anchor points simultaneously at maximum speed—the highest risk but most time-efficient approach

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, and the True Qi in his body surged madly. Sword lights tore through the air, transforming into nine凌厉剑气直取九根黑铁锁链！圣宗长老的禁制瞬间被触发，反噬之力如狂潮般向他涌来——但他的眼中，只有祭坛上那道纤细的身影。

choices.text: Infiltrate and Destroy One by One
choices.description: Sneak in and destroy the anchor points—high safety but excessively time-consuming
choices.risk_hint: The ritual may be impossible to interrupt before completion

text.content: Chen Ji收敛气息，化作一道暗影穿梭于祭坛周围。他找到一个隐蔽的角落，指尖凝聚出一道细如发丝的剑气，悄无声息地刺入第一道锚点——然而，就在锚点崩碎的瞬间，祭坛上的符文骤然加速运转！
